CREATURE/GOBLINSHREDDERMOUNT/GOBLINSHRED.note: I-364: the client HANGS whenever this mesh plays a combat animation. Confirmed with `.morph 31484` and attacking on foot, so no vehicle is involved. Cause: sequences 5 and 6 (Attack1H) are flagged 0x40 ALIAS with no 0x20 PRIMARY bit, pointing at sequence 54 -- which is flagged 0x0 (neither primary nor alias) and whose aliasNext is ITSELF. Alias resolution therefore never reaches a sequence that claims to own the data. Both attacks in fact carry their own data (52 bones/940 keyframes and 51/835), so the repair is to stop lying about it: mark them primary (0x21). Sequence 54 (UseStandingLoop) is left at 0x0 ON PURPOSE: its keyframes live in the external GOBLINSHREDDERMOUNT0123-00.ANIM, and flagging it 0x20 made the client read them from the .m2 -> NaN bones -> NaN-positioned model sounds -> FMOD INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO #132 at 0x0094BF6B on every Throw Footbomb (I-248). Keeps the Nexus HD mesh -- Blizzard never updated this model's geometry (1484 verts in stock, Cata AND current retail; the HD pack is 6613), so a retail retroport cannot provide the HD look. globalFlags 0x90 -> 0x10 matches stock's flag word.

CREATURE/ZEPSHREDDERMOUNT/ZEPSHREDDERMOU.note: Same HD mesh byte-for-byte under the I-248 self-contained path (display 26559, Bilgewater Buccaneer). Identical repair.
